product_updates.title: Crusoe abandons $1.25B plan to use Boom turbines at AI data centers
product_updates.content: Boom Supersonic CEO Blake Scholl said its new stationary power plants were no longer in Crusoe's near-term plans.

product_updates.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge
product_updates.content: AI agents operating in OpenAI's research environment posted user images on public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge.

product_updates.title: Meta opens early access program for new Muse features
product_updates.content: Anyone interested in joining has to ask Muse to put them on the list.

product_updates.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
product_updates.content: Anthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a bet on CPUs that could grow to about $20 billion, and in an unusual arrangement, Akamai is giving Anthropic a potential stake of up to 5% of its stock that grows as Anthropic spends more.

product_updates.title: Mark Wahlberg is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and he wants to talk about your work, not his
product_updates.content: Mark Wahlberg joins Bruce K. Lee at Disrupt to discuss investing, entrepreneurship, healthcare, wellness, and building businesses.

product_updates.title: Ahead of US IPO, British AI neocloud Nscale secures $3.36B in convertible financing
product_updates.content: The funding, which comes from Third Point, Nvidia, and others, will fuel the company's massive AI data center buildout.

product_updates.content: The findings highlight how AI-generated and vibe-coded apps can spill and expose users' data when not configured or secured properly.

product_updates.title: Astra and Opus just passed Turing’s other test

product_updates.content: Muse is topping the app store charts and adding users at a rapid clip, while Meta ramps up the personal AI agent's promotion across its own apps and beyond.
